name: B10-0445/2025 – § 121
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: Highlights the in-depth revision of the EU’s energy legislation under the ‘Fit for 55’ package, which has aligned it with the EU’s increased GHG emission reduction target of at least 55 % by 2030 in order to reach climate neutrality at the latest by 2050 and which must now be effectively implemented; believes that other Parties should follow similar and relevant efforts;
